entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or questions about an existing order, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I assist you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about an order. I bought a jersey a while ago, and I finally got a chance to try it on for a ride, but it's the wrong size.
I'm sorry to hear that it wasn't a perfect fit. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you happen to have the order number?
Yes, it's... one moment... VF-9821-4554. It's just so much tighter than I expected. I was hoping I could exchange it or something. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and never had this issue.
Of course. Let me just pull up that order. VF-9821-4554. Okay, I see the Men's Velocity jersey, and it looks like it was delivered about 76 days ago. Is that correct?
Oh, wow, has it really been that long? I... I feel terrible for waiting so long. Things have just been so stressful. I was really hoping I could get that money back, I really need it right now.
I completely understand. Let me just confirm the return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. Good news! Our standard apparel items, like that jersey, have a 10-day return window. So you are unfortunately outside the timeframe to send it back.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you.
It's no problem at all. Since the jersey was too tight, would you like to set up an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a refund?
Honestly, a refund would be best right now. I can always re-order when my budget is a bit better. I just need to return it because it was the wrong size.

I can certainly process a return for a full refund. I've just sent an email to you with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That sounds perfect. You've been so helpful, Diana. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
